target.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides
target.body:
Closes #105959

AI-assisted. I reviewed the affected runtime paths and understand the changes. A redacted agent transcript is omitted unless maintainers request one.

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a maintenance problem where core production code exposed 111 distinct `OPENCLAW_*` environment-variable reads, including undocumented aliases and test controls that duplicated canonical config, upstream variables, or injected seams.

## Why This Change Was Made

This audits the entire baseline surface and removes only seven undocumented variables with no docs, installer, extension, workflow, or named packaged-runtime contract. Documented variables remain unchanged. Ambiguous user-facing variables remain as explicit follow-up decisions instead of being silently removed.

Removed paths:

- three OpenClaw-prefixed ClawHub aliases; canonical `CLAWHUB_*` variables remain
- terminal clear/cursor overrides; persisted settings remain canonical
- session-manager TTL and lock-watchdog test env controls; injected/direct test seams remain

Production TypeScript drops 18 net lines.

## User Impact

Supported, documented environment behavior is unchanged. Unsupported hidden overrides no longer compete with canonical settings. This patch removes seven names from the audited 111-variable baseline, and non-test code shrinks. The same production-source scan now reports 106 matches: 104 surviving baseline names plus two post-baseline computed-access identifiers added by `main`.

## Evidence

- Baseline inventory: 111 variables from the requested production-source scan.
- Patch effect: seven audited variables removed; all seven names have zero repository references. Baseline math is 111 - 7 = 104. The rebased current tree reports 106 scan matches because `main` added two separately classified computed-access identifiers after the baseline.
- Focused Blacksmith Testbox proof on the patch-identical surviving touched runtime/test surface: `tbx_01kxcvydtvp6k68vp5j52097w6` / workflow run 29224200888 — 161 passed, 2 skipped across cache, lock, ClawHub, dotenv, and ClawHub-install E2E tests. Later audit commits only rebased and restored unchanged `main` telemetry behavior.
- Same tested surface: `pnpm tsgo:core` plus targeted core/scripts oxlint passed.
- Exact-head Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd5e5t6qkjptppv4ysjtmgs` / workflow run 29231630626: `pnpm tsgo:prod` passed after rebasing onto repaired `main`.
- Exact-head hosted CI run 29231562354 at `de9128701e0`: 72 succeeded, 35 skipped, zero failures.
- `pnpm format:check` on all touched source/test files: pass after formatting.
- `git diff --check`: pass.
- Direct Codex contract check at `openai/codex@c888e8e75a9f0e90ce7d5517f8b9540832cbbf76`: `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2/thread.rs:494`, `:629`, `:1070`, and `:1275`; `codex-rs/app-server/src/message_processor.rs:1047`; and `codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs:500`, `:693`, `:1412`, `:1565`, `:1730`, `:1962`, `:2236`, and `:3440` confirm the gated list/read/fork/archive/unarchive/name operations are real app-server methods.
- Autoreview proof gap: the final exact-head fail-closed helper run refused the patch because existing synthetic token fixtures in changed ClawHub test hunks match its secret-like-content detector. No credential is present. Whole-module/caller/test manual review plus focused remote proof substituted; the helper exposes no override.
- ClawSweeper P1 resolved: retained `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` because its source names a packaged-launcher/CI contract; fresh focused autoreview of the restoration was clean.

### Classification legend

- **D+U** — DOCUMENTED + USED; keep.
- **U/F** — undocumented user-facing runtime behavior; keep pending a maintainer follow-up decision to document, replace with config/CLI, or remove.
- **T/D/I** — test, development, packaging, or process-internal control with a concrete setter/caller; keep, not a general user-facing env contract.
- **R** — dead or clearly redundant undocumented path; removed here.

### Post-baseline `main` additions

These landed after the requested 111-variable baseline and are not rows in that fixed baseline table. Their current reads use injected or computed env access. Because the requested regex's unescaped dot also matches `[`, the scan now prints their identifier names too: 106 total matches = 104 fixed-baseline survivors + 2 post-baseline additions.

| Variable | Class | Decision / evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OPENCLAW_DEBUG_PROXY_ENABLED` | T/D/I | Diagnostic proxy control with CLI, QA, extension-test, and fetch-guard callers. Keep internal. |
| `OPENCLAW_WRAPPER` | T/D/I | Gateway service wrapper install/repair/status contract. Keep internal. The requested grep prints the computed-access constant name `OPENCLAW_WRAPPER_ENV_KEY`; the actual environment key is `OPENCLAW_WRAPPER`. |
